name: CDC Marsden Park MP1 (DC1)

address.note: Campus street address (both lots); building position within campus not published.

lat.note: Not geocoded: Nominatim and all mapping hosts blocked by the session egress proxy. Geocode from 105 Hollinsworth Road, Marsden Park NSW 2765 later.

lon.note: Not geocoded: Nominatim and all mapping hosts blocked by the session egress proxy. Geocode from 105 Hollinsworth Road, Marsden Park NSW 2765 later.

builder.note: Head contractor per iCost project page for an AU$65m CDC Marsden Park package; package scope (likely MP1 initial stage under DA-24-00542) not confirmed; builder for later MP1 stage (MP1.S2) unknown.

developer.note: Applicant for SSD-70889211 (Mecone acted as planning consultant)

mw_it.note: Estimate: campus 504 MW IT / 6 buildings = 84 MW average; datacentermap lists DC5 at 84 MW. Per-building IT MW in the EIS not confirmed (EIS not directly readable). CDC Mar 2026 says campus expanded to 700MW+ after densification, so per-building figure may rise.

mw_grid.note: Not stated separately. SSD describes 'total power consumption of 504 MW' for the campus and a 720 MW/MVA substation (campus-level).

cost_aud_m.note: Campus total capital investment value for all six buildings under SSD-70889211 (not broken down per building). SEARs request stated AU$1.4bn (source 7).

authority.note: Determined by departmental delegate (Director) per source 19

lodged.note: EIS documents dated 1-4 Nov 2024; SEARs requested 15 May 2024 (source 8). Exact lodgement date not confirmed.

determined.note: Approval announced 28 Nov 2025; project list notes cite 27 Nov 2025. Exact consent date not confirmed (portal blocked). MP1 initial stage also approved under council DA-24-00542 (source 12).

jobs_construction.note: CAMPUS TOTAL (all six buildings). NSW ministerial release (search extract): '220 construction jobs'; basis not defined - check EIS

jobs_construction_other.note: CAMPUS TOTAL. Information Age (search extract): '200 construction jobs'; differs from ministerial release

jobs_operational.note: CAMPUS TOTAL at full operation. NSW ministerial release (search extract): '265 operational jobs'; Information Age also reports 265

construction_start.note: Campus ground-breaking; initial works under council DA-24-00542 (5 MW facility).

construction_end.note: iCost reports CDC announced completion of MP1 (first building); date not found. EIS: MP1.S2 in Stage 1 (1.5 yrs construction).

open_questions: MP1 appears split: initial 5 MW facility under Blacktown DA-24-00542 (SCCPP PPSSCC-562, CIV $53.94m, lodged ~17 Jun 2024) and MP1.S2 under SSD-70889211; determination date of DA-24-00542 not found
iCost reports MP1 completion announced; confirm date and whether full building or initial stage only
